title: Tama 3D
description: Raise a tiny 3D companion, balance its needs, play a timing minigame, unlock evolutions, and restyle its pocket device.

mintAssets.brief: A full life-stage family of expressive pocket-pet characters.
Colorful handheld device shells and decorative controls.
Bedroom, meadow, ocean, and galaxy backdrops.

experience: Feed, clean, play with, and rest a persistent virtual companion.
Grow through multiple life stages and customize the device theme.
prompt.visualDirection: Soft candy colors, rounded toy plastic, pixel-display cues, and warm miniature dioramas.

thumbnail.alt: A cheerful 3D pocket pet inside a pastel virtual-pet device.

social.title: Tama 3D — Raise a Pocket Friend
social.description: Care, play, evolve, and customize a tiny persistent 3D companion.
